title: Singer House
statementMd:
It is known that passages in Singer house are complex and intertwined. Let's define a Singer $*k*$-house as a graph built by the following process: take complete binary tree of height $*k*$ and add edges from each vertex to all its successors, if they are not yet present.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/14239d4fb4f7faa16bd2b311ce7bfac2e55e7ca7.png) Singer $4$-house

Count the number of non-empty paths in Singer $*k*$-house which do not pass the same vertex twice. Two paths are distinct if the sets or the orders of visited vertices are different. Since the answer can be large, output it modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

## Input

The only line contains single integer $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ 400$).

## Output

Print single integer — the answer for the task modulo $10^{9} + 7$.

## Note

There are $9$ paths in the first example (the vertices are numbered on the picture below): `1`, `2`, `3`, `1-2`, `2-1`, `1-3`, `3-1`, `2-1-3`, `3-1-2`.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fa51cfc631d414ac49c5a76738c00bd55bcd5717.png) Singer $2$-house
statementZhMd:
## 题目描述

众所周知，Singer 房屋中的通道复杂且相互交错。我们将 Singer $*k*$-房屋定义为按以下过程构造的图：取一棵高度为 $*k*$ 的完全二叉树，并从每个顶点向它的所有后继顶点添加边（如果这些边尚不存在）。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/14239d4fb4f7faa16bd2b311ce7bfac2e55e7ca7.png) Singer $4$-房屋

请计算 Singer $*k*$-房屋中不重复经过同一顶点的非空路径数量。若访问过的顶点集合或访问顺序不同，则认为两条路径不同。由于答案可能很大，请将其对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模后输出。

## 输入格式

唯一一行包含一个整数 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 400$）。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——问题的答案对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模后的结果。

## 说明

第一个样例中共有 $9$ 条路径（下图中的顶点已编号）：`1`、`2`、`3`、`1-2`、`2-1`、`1-3`、`3-1`、`2-1-3`、`3-1-2`。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/fa51cfc631d414ac49c5a76738c00bd55bcd5717.png) Singer $2$-房屋
